content:
Nano Banana (Google's Gemini image model) true inference cost is roughly $0.04–$0.08 per image—based on 10–25 seconds of high-end GPU time at current cloud rates (~$2–4/hr for H100-class hardware), plus power/network overhead.

Dominant models (2026 estimates, operational compute only, not API markup):
- Stable Diffusion (XL/3): $0.001–$0.005
- Flux (Schnell/Dev/Pro): $0.005–$0.04
- GPT Image 1.5 / DALL-E: $0.02–$0.10
- Imagen 4 / Nano Banana variants: $0.04–$0.08
- Midjourney: $0.03–$0.07

These scale with resolution/steps; optimizations and volume drop them further. Local runs on consumer GPUs can hit near-zero marginal cost.
